name: search_datasets
description: Search U.S. government open datasets on Data.gov by keyword. Returns titles, descriptions, organizations, formats, and download URLs. Example: search_datasets("climate change", organization: "noaa-gov").

name: get_dataset
description: Get full metadata for a specific Data.gov dataset by its ID or name. Returns title, description, resources (download links), organization, tags, and update frequency.

id.description: Dataset ID or name slug from Data.gov

name: list_organizations
description: List all organizations publishing datasets on Data.gov. Returns organization names and dataset counts. Useful for discovering data publishers.
